name: diet-webapp
description: The single-page app both Dieters and Coaches use: Dieters set goals, plan meals from the recipe catalog, log food, track weight, and order lunch by having it sent as a WhatsApp message to the restaurant; Coaches view their connected Dieters' plans and progress and leave feedback. It renders UI only and never calls WhatsApp or the nutrition database directly — all of that goes through diet-api.

dependencies.name: diet-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Diet Manager API for all goals, plans, logs, recipes, weight, coach and ordering data.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs Dieters and Coaches in via SSO.
